name: Your Move: Door A or Door B
why_it_works: A realistic dilemma with two reasonable choices puts the viewer inside the decision before they know they're learning. Committing to A or B in the comments makes them invested in the outcome, and seeing where each path leads shows the advisor's judgment better than any credential could.

hook.pattern: Drop the viewer into a common money or life decision and ask what they'd do.
examples: Two choices. Both sound smart. One ages better.
Your move. Comment A or B before the answer.

craft.notes: Make both doors genuinely reasonable so the comments split close to 50/50; a one-sided dilemma gets no debate. The payoff is 'it depends on one thing', which naturally leads to the consult without a hard sell.

do_not: State outcomes as certainties or use real client numbers without consent
Give individual advice in comment replies
compliance: Financial advisors: label scenarios as hypothetical and educational, not personalized advice; no return, income or savings promises; run through your firm's compliance review
Mortgage: no guaranteed rates or approvals; show your NMLS ID and Equal Housing Opportunity where required
Insurance: never imply a claim will be paid or coverage applies without checking policy terms; show license number where required
Real estate: show the brokerage name, follow fair housing rules, and don't predict home values
